svg.title: Coherence-Velocity Trap mechanism chain
svg.desc: A reinforcing feedback loop showing how capital architecture drives deployment velocity, which generates competitive pressure, accelerating the race, narrowing observation channels, excluding risk signals, accumulating vulnerabilities, forcing crisis accommodation, then reasserting deployment velocity in a tightening cycle

sendPrompt('What risks get excluded in the AI race?')
sendPrompt('What kind of crises force AI governance changes?')
